facts.text: A humid world with marshlands and swamps on its single continent, it was the homeworld of the amphibian Shawda Ubb species.

evidence.quote: A humid world with marshlands and swamps on its single continent, it was the homeworld of the amphibian Shawda Ubb species.

facts.text: The substance was shipped to factories in Manpha's sole spaceport community, the capital city Shanpan, where it was processed into plastics for export offworld.

evidence.quote: The substance was shipped to factories in Manpha's sole spaceport community, the capital city Shanpan, where it was processed into plastics for export offworld.

facts.text: Atypically for a Shawda Ubb, the Manpha native Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon desired to travel beyond Manpha.

evidence.quote: Atypically for a Shawda Ubb, the Manpha native Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon desired to travel beyond Manpha.

facts.text: In order to earn money to fulfill that goal, Tivtotolon played music and carried news to isolated communities across Manpha's continent.

evidence.quote: In order to earn money to fulfill that goal, Tivtotolon played music and carried news to isolated communities across Manpha's continent.

facts.text: Eventually, the Shawda Ubb traveled to Shanpan, where he adopted the stage name "Rappertunie," and when the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure and the Max Rebo Band visited Manpha at some point by 4 ABY, Rappertunie joined the band and accompanied Jabba and the musicians off Manpha.

evidence.quote: Eventually, the Shawda Ubb traveled to Shanpan, where he adopted the stage name "Rappertunie," and when the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure and the Max Rebo Band visited Manpha at some point by 4 ABY, Rappertunie joined the band and accompanied Jabba and the musicians off Manpha.

facts.text: A small world, Manpha had a single continent that featured marshlands and swamps.

facts.text: Manpha's marshes featured swamp grasses and fish.

evidence.quote: Manpha's marshes featured swamp grasses and fish.

facts.text: The planet also shared its name with the creature known as Manpha-fowl.

evidence.quote: The planet also shared its name with the creature known as Manpha-fowl.

facts.text: By 17 BBY, Manpha was not a part of the territory controlled by the Republic's successor, the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: By 17 BBY, Manpha was not a part of the territory controlled by the Republic's successor, the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: From the day he hatched from his egg, the Manpha native Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon had an obssessive urge—in contrast to the rest of the planet's Shawda Ubb species—to travel and explore the entire galaxy, one planet at a time.

evidence.quote: From the day he hatched from his egg, the Manpha native Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon had an obssessive urge—in contrast to the rest of the planet's Shawda Ubb species—to travel and explore the entire galaxy, one planet at a time.

facts.text: After Tivtotolon learned about the city of Shanpan, Manpha's sole spaceport community, the young Shawda Ubb devoted his every waking hour to earning enough credits to travel there.

evidence.quote: After Tivtotolon learned about the city of Shanpan, Manpha's sole spaceport community, the young Shawda Ubb devoted his every waking hour to earning enough credits to travel there.

facts.text: He traveled extensively through the marsh communities of Manpha's continent, getting paid for playing music and carrying news to isolated villages.

evidence.quote: He traveled extensively through the marsh communities of Manpha's continent, getting paid for playing music and carrying news to isolated villages.

facts.text: The population of the Manpha system around 25 ABY numbered between ten and one hundred million.

evidence.quote: The population of the Manpha system around 25 ABY numbered between ten and one hundred million.

facts.text: The Shawda Ubb inhabited hundreds of thousands of small towns and villages scattered across the marshes and swamps of Manpha's continent.

evidence.quote: The Shawda Ubb inhabited hundreds of thousands of small towns and villages scattered across the marshes and swamps of Manpha's continent.

facts.text: The substance was sold to national oil companies based in Manpha's capital city, Shanpan, where factories processed the oil into high-grade plastics that were subsequently exported offworld.

evidence.quote: The substance was sold to national oil companies based in Manpha's capital city, Shanpan, where factories processed the oil into high-grade plastics that were subsequently exported offworld.

facts.text: Shanpan was the only spaceport community on Manpha, and a large network of orbital transports and shuttles serviced the Shawda Ubb oil companies.

evidence.quote: Shanpan was the only spaceport community on Manpha, and a large network of orbital transports and shuttles serviced the Shawda Ubb oil companies.
